'''''Santolina impressa''''' is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Asteraceae]], [[endemic]] to southwest [[Portugal]] specifically the area between [[Setúbal]] and [[Sines]]. It inhabits [[psammophilous]] scrub in stabilized dunes (often paleodunes), sometimes under pine forests. On acidic sandy soils, becoming particularly abundant in somewhat disturbed places.<ref name="iucn status 19 November 2021" /><ref name=iucn />
